text: {"name":"ble_link_poll","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Scans linked Bluetooth link contexts to process TX completions, link activity, and BLE event dispatch.","subsystem":"ble","var_renames":{"v0":"link_ctx","v1":"status_blk","v3":"tick_ptr","v4":"now_ticks","v5":"event_count","v7":"link_active","v8":"event_sent","v9":"active_count"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":0,"meaning":"link_ctx: next pointer in connection list"},{"offset":106,"meaning":"link_ctx: connection state byte, required to be 2"},{"offset":108,"meaning":"link_ctx: TX-valid/enable byte"},{"offset":116,"meaning":"link_ctx: BLE event dispatch context"},{"offset":144,"meaning":"link_ctx: saved activity byte from offset 107"},{"offset":145,"meaning":"link_ctx: activity reset byte"},{"offset":224,"meaning":"link_ctx: queue/head or activity index compared with offset 225"},{"offset":225,"meaning":"link_ctx: queue/tail or activity index compared with offset 224"},{"offset":226,"meaning":"link_ctx: link ready/active byte"},{"offset":4,"meaning":"status_blk: active event/link counter word"},{"offset":8,"meaning":"status_blk: processed/poll flag byte"},{"offset":9,"meaning":"status_blk: pending event flag byte"}]}
